name: Sensei to Watashi.
source:
The girl who said to be the prettiest in the school declared love to you! 
You asked her how much she was serious, and her answer was "To the point where I can do anything you want me to do."
To test her feeling, you call her up anywhere and anytime to have her do various naughty things! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048291.html]DLsite English[/url]]
